## What Riverside Agentsdoes.

Riverside Agents is a team of AI agents built only for video. A Producer preps your session, an Editor turns raw recordings into a finished episode, a Clipper cuts the best moments into social clips, and a Marketer writes captions and schedules posts. You choose how much to automate, and nothing is published until you approve it. Included in every Riverside plan, with a 14-day free trial. [...] Will Riverside Agents publish content without approval?

No. Nothing is published until you approve it.

Can I choose how much work to automate?

Yes. Riverside Agents lets you choose how much of the video workflow to automate.

Is Riverside Agents included in Riverside plans?

The supplied description states that Riverside Agents is included in every Riverside plan and lists a 14-day free trial.

## Frequently Asked Questions

### What are Riverside Agents?

Riverside Agents are a team of AI specialists built only for video. The Producer helps you prep and supports you while you record. The Editor turns your recording into a finished episode, the Clipper finds the moments worth sharing, and the Marketer gets everything out across your channels. You make the calls. [...] General-purpose AI does a bit of everything. Riverside Agents only do video, and they work natively inside Riverside. That gives them direct access to your recordings and to Riverside’s own production tools, built specifically for conversations and talking head videos: removing pauses, cutting filler words, building rough cuts and more. Each agent runs on proprietary AI built for its one job, so it knows what great video looks like. That focus also keeps things fast: you can edit, clip and publish full episodes without hitting your AI usage limit halfway through.

# Riverside Launches Riverside Agents, the First AI Production Team Built for Video

Press Release · Palo Alto CA, United States · via Riverside ·

Riverside, the AI-powered end-to-end content creation platform used by Spotify, NBC and the New York Times, today launched Riverside Agents: the first team of AI agents built specifically for video production. The agents take on the production work around a recording, from prepping the session to publishing the clips, and move it forward on their own. Riverside Agents are available today on web and mobile across all Riverside plans. [...] Producer preps the session and runs the studio: interview questions, talking points, scenes, layouts and branding, all ready to shape before recording starts.
 Editor turns a full-length recording into a finished episode. It proposes the editorial calls, like where to tighten the conversation and which moment makes the hook, and takes direction on what stays. Then it brings the edit to life with layouts, B-roll and motion graphics, and polishes the audio, captions and branding.
 Clipper finds the moments worth sharing and turns each one into a finished clip that’s ready to post.
 Marketer gets every clip live in the right places. It writes the post copy, creates thumbnails and plans where each clip should run, then posts or schedules it across social channels once approved. [...] > "Every creator deserves a production team. Riverside Agents give them one: a Producer, an Editor, a Clipper and a Marketer that know their show, get to work the moment recording ends, and bring back work creators are proud to put their name on. Their job is to direct.” — Nadav Keyson, CEO and Co-founder, Riverside

Riverside logo

## About Riverside

Riverside is the AI-powered end-to-end content creation platform for podcasters, creators and businesses. More than 40 million sessions have been recorded on Riverside, and its customers include Spotify, NBC and the New York Times. Founded in 2019 by brothers Nadav and Gideon Keyson, Riverside is headquartered in Tel Aviv. Learn more at riverside.com.
